content: Starfield archives are .ba2 v2/v3. Third-party mods overwhelmingly ship loose files (needing the StarfieldCustom.ini archive-invalidation edit) OR .ba2 named after their plugin which auto-load when the plugin is active. Loose files + plugins.txt cover the ~95% third-party case; explicit ba2 registration (sResourceArchiveList2) is an edge case. No archive repack needed by the manager for the common case.
